request.raw_text: Reduce overall height of Nozzle Volcano part by 1mm, reduction should be made in threaded area.

areas_to_change.action: Shorten by 1 mm along the nozzle axis
areas_to_change.reference_geometry: Threaded cylindrical shank of the Nozzle Volcano part
areas_to_change.location: Within the external threaded area above the hexagonal wrench section
areas_to_change.description: Reduce the axial length of the threaded section by 1 mm so that the nozzle's overall height is reduced by exactly 1 mm. Maintain the existing thread diameter, pitch, profile, and coaxial alignment.

areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve its size, shape, axial thickness, and position relative to the nozzle tip.
Preserve the external tip geometry, outlet diameter, and internal flow passage.
Preserve thread diameter, pitch, handedness, and profile; only reduce its available axial length.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Nozzle center axis and internal bore
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve concentricity, bore geometry, and flow-path alignment.
Do not modify surrounding heater-block, heatsink, fastener, or mounting geometries.

predicted_final_outcome.geometry: The Nozzle Volcano part will be 1 mm shorter overall, with the reduction confined to its externally threaded shank. The hexagonal body, conical tip, and internal passage will remain unchanged.
predicted_final_outcome.function: The nozzle will retain the same thread compatibility, wrench engagement, outlet geometry, and material-flow function while having 1 mm less threaded engagement length.
predicted_final_outcome.behavior: When installed, the shortened nozzle may seat or project 1 mm differently depending on the mating threaded interface, but its threading and extrusion behavior should otherwise remain unchanged.

ambiguities.description: The request does not specify which end or subsection of the threaded area should absorb the 1 mm reduction.
candidate_interpretations: Trim 1 mm from the free end of the threaded shank, moving its terminal face toward the hexagonal section.
Remove 1 mm adjacent to the hexagonal section and translate the remaining threaded portion toward the hex.
Shorten the threaded span parametrically while preserving the existing thread termination style at both ends.
